description: Significant changes on your watched apps and keywords, newest first: type, one-line title, AI summary, significance (0–1), app, country and the key payload fields (version, changes old → new, rating drop, rank move, chart rank…). Filter by type, app, watch, since and min_significance. To check for news, pass since = the created_at of the newest event already handled. Cost: 0 credits.

app.description: Only events of this app (any id, bundle id, package, URL or name).

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

min_significance.description: Only events at least this significant (0–1).

since.description: Only items at or after this ISO date / datetime. Example: 2026-10-01

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

type.description: Comma list of event types, e.g. 'new_version,rating_drop'. Types: new_version, metadata_change, price_change, featured, in_app_event, installs_milestone, rating_drop, ratings_spike, review_spike, negative_review_spike, chart_enter, chart_leave, rank_change, keyword_entrant.

watch.description: Only events of this watch id.

name: get_events
title: Get Events
